title: Time course of swept-source optical coherence tomography angiography findings after photodynamic therapy and aflibercept in eyes with age-related macular degeneration

groups.agent: full-fluence verteporfin PDT followed immediately by intravitreal aflibercept 2 mg
groups.description: Neovascular AMD with type 1 CNV or polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy, all previously treated with anti-VEGF and/or PDT; one session of PDT plus aflibercept

exclusions.what: tbl1 per-eye BCVA columns Pre, 1M, 2M and 3M (C8-C11, R3-R7)
exclusions.reason: Unit not established (protocol inclusion 2; brief ruling on units): neither the table, its footnote nor the Methods state logMAR or ETDRS letters, and the case descriptions report Snellen and decimal acuity. No admissible series remains.

exclusions.what: tbl1 exudative change, CNV signal size, GLD and CNV-choroid connection columns
